Although to be fair, these bird-like beings were also the only other sentient life they had discovered on this expedition.

The march towards the fabled home of the Saen was a long and arduous journey, and here was an opportunity for a new ally, and to hasten the process. After all, the War in the Heavens will not cease.

*****

The Southern Roost, fabled outpost of the Schryke civilization. At least that was what the birds called it. Castor gazed upon the outpost, and bade a salutation to the guards. "Hello Schrykes, we mean no harm, in fact, I believe we have a proposition for you..."

"Surely by now you have seen the disorder and chaos spread by the war between the gods. The collective idleness of all the races of Gaea have only allowed the chaos to spread and escalate. I believe it is in our common interest to try to stop the suffering invoked by this war."

Castor paused, trying to gauge the interest in the guards.

"I understand that you are beings and guardians of order, that you pride yourselves on the discipline that you have created. Doesn't it pain you so to see Gaea suffer through such disorder in this eon of strife? Our proposal is simple, help us reach the Saen, in the Forest of Brotherhood, and we will do all that we can to put an end to this madness that has struck our world."

Castor looked again, but found no purchase in the disciplined minds of the Schrykes.

"It is only through our inaction that chaos is allowed to grow, please, I implore you. Aid us in your venture, help us return a semblance of order to our beloved homeland. Already you have lost many of your people. If we do not act now, what else may be lost?"

Castor sat there in silence, waiting for a response.
